what: Cited 'IntHout 2016 BMJ Open 6:e011458' from memory. PubMed shows that identifier is the AXIS cross-sectional appraisal tool.
fix: Removed; policy: verify every reference by record lookup before use.

what: BCG reference values were recalled from memory.
fix: Replaced by R/metafor output on metadat::dat.bcg (validation/reference/reference.json).

what: Ignored the continuity correction, giving variance 0 for zero-event studies.
Hedges' J used approximation 1-3/(4df-1); ~1% error at df=2.
fix: Exact gamma form; approximation retained only for comparison.

what: Only one SMD variance formula offered; metafor/Hedges-Olkin and Borenstein differ up to ~8% at tiny n.
Only Q-based I-squared reported; metafor prints tau2-based I-squared; earlier tests never checked I-squared.
HKSJ with identical effects raised ZeroDivisionError.
fix: Returns NaN + warning (metafor returns p=0; deliberate deviation).
Rewritten: no estimator universally best; conditions and sensitivity-analysis stance stated (see C009, C010).

what: BCG allocation-method vector typed from memory was wrong.
fix: Taken from R export and asserted equal in tests.

what: Recalled DOI for Koricheva & Gurevitch 2014 pointed to an unrelated paper; recalled title of Jones 2005 was wrong.
fix: DOIs/titles now taken from Crossref records; tools/verify_refs.py rejects author/year mismatches.

what: Query for science-education storytelling translated 'STEM' to plant stems/electron microscopy (1340 irrelevant hits); two over-narrow queries returned 0.
fix: Recorded as invalid/misleading in topic_scan.py with explicit caveats.

what: Mantel-Haenszel/Peto applied the 0.5 continuity correction to the tables; metafor computes the estimate from uncorrected tables (correction affects only per-study effects for Q). RD variance used Greenland-Robins; metafor uses the Sato et al. estimator.
Q-profile CI bounds were swapped; Begg p-value used the asymptotic test while R reports the exact Kendall test for n<50 without ties.
fix: Fixed and benchmarked; documented metafor's uniroot tolerance.

what: Several tutorial check values were mental arithmetic and wrong; R checks passed vacuously on NULL (stopifnot(logical(0))).
fix: Values computed from code; R checks use isTRUE; reference solutions run in tests.

what: Worked example contained invented numbers ('0.073 to 0.069').
Collaborator names were written into the audit log and therefore into 'shareable' backups.
fix: Names are no longer logged; test asserts no personal details in audit rows.

what: First accessibility run reported 0 violations on 18 views, but 3 mobile views could not be opened (collapsed sidebar) and were silently counted as clean.
fix: Tool opens the mobile sidebar with retries and exits non-zero if any page cannot be opened; re-run audited all 18 views.

what: axe-core found low-contrast captions (15 views) and skipped heading levels (4 views).
fix: Global accessible CSS; real h2 headings.
